chunks: And Ali, may the blessings of Allah be upon him, said:
"Whoever among you travels with a riding animal should begin, when stopping, by feeding it and giving it water."

key_terms.دَابَّةٍ: a riding animal or beast used for travel

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام teach about caring for animals during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches proper conduct toward animals during travel, instructing that their needs be attended to first upon stopping. It reflects mercy, responsibility, and recognition of the rights of animals in Islam.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2481 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Whoever among you travels with an animal should begin, when stopping, by feeding and giving water to it."
